verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is runtime probes showing that the vendor's help pages (the sources page and the public-notebooks page) can be fetched as crawlable HTML without a key or login. That means an agent could be pointed at the documentation, but the pages are ordinary human-oriented help articles, not llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: an llms.txt file, agent-oriented or Markdown docs, a machine-readable docs index, and any first-party statement about agent consumption of the docs.
